assays.assay_description: Mice with surgically implanted head-mounted neodymium magnets were placed in a 12.5 cm glass cylinder surrounded by a magnetometer coil immediately after IP drug injection. HTR activity (head twitches identified by signal criteria) was recorded for 30 min. Multiple compounds across dose ranges were tested in a between-subjects design with at least 7 days between repeated sessions in the same animal.

outcomes.summary: All 17 tested 4-hydroxy and 4-acetoxy N,N-dialkyltryptamines induced head twitches in male C57BL/6J mice following an inverted-U dose-response curve, with ED50 values ranging from 0.17 mg/kg (psilocin) to 1.41 mg/kg (4-AcO-DIPT). Potency was inversely related to the steric bulk of N-alkyl substituents (Charton's upsilon parameter; R = -0.83, p = 0.011 for 4-hydroxy series). O-acetylation did not reliably alter HTR potency relative to the corresponding 4-hydroxy compound, consistent with the 4-acetoxy tryptamines acting as prodrugs.
outcomes.statistics: HTR counts analyzed by one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post hoc (α = 0.05); ED50 values with 95% CI computed by nonlinear regression. Correlation of -log ED50 with Charton's υ: R = -0.8283, p = 0.011 (4-hydroxy); R = -0.7208, p = 0.043 (4-acetoxy).
outcomes.evidence: All of the compounds induce head twitches in mice, consistent with an LSD-like behavioral profile... the HTR followed an inverted-U-shaped dose-response function.

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR counts were analyzed using one-way analyses of variance (ANOVA).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Figure 2 depicts the time course of the HTR... Data are presented as group means during consecutive 2-min time bins.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is a reflexive motor response, not a learning task.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Head twitches identified by magnetometer signal thresholding (waveform criteria), not pose-estimation or ML behavioural classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate ANOVA and nonlinear regression reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: recorded for 30 min in a 12.5 cm glass cylinder surrounded by a magnetometer coil

E2_shelter.evidence: Glass cylinder, no enclosed refuge (definitionally absent).

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in test cylinder.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in test cylinder.

E6_spatial.evidence: 12.5 cm glass cylinder is a single compartment.

E8_food_water.evidence: ad libitum access to food and water, except during behavioral testing

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR activity was recorded for 30 min in a 12.5 cm glass cylinder (one session per drug administration).

D2_session_duration.evidence: HTR activity was recorded for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each compound/dose tested in a single 30-min session per animal; repeated dosing across sessions reflects retesting in different conditions, not multiple recording days for one assay condition.

D4_baseline.evidence: Test compounds were injected immediately prior to testing; no pre-drug baseline recorded.

D5_followup.evidence: Only acute recording for 30 min after injection; no >=24h follow-up recording.

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single behavioural assay (HTR); consolidated to one entry.

B7 set to 0: head-twitches detected from magnetometer voltage thresholding does not meet the rubric's definition of automated behavioural classification (pose estimation, syllable extraction, or supervised ML).

D3 set to 1 (recording days = 1 per assay condition): although animals were reused across months with >=7 days between sessions, each tested condition is a single recording session per animal — same paradigm repeated under different drug conditions.
setup_restrain set to 'no' (modal): mice freely moved within the cylinder; the head-mounted magnet is not a restraint.
Dose ranges for individual compounds were not reported in the main text (only ED50 values); doses_mg_per_kg left empty with explanatory doses_raw.
